title: Kazehane: Skywing Bay
description: Spread glowing sky-wings over a sunlit anime seaside bay! Glide beside the ocean tram, dive past shrine torii gates, shatter parallel worlds, and rewind time on a whim.
controls: WASD roam, F spread wings & fly, E ride the ocean tram, Tab shatter parallel worlds, Mouse look.

zh-CN.title: 风羽屿：振翅御风
zh-CN.description: 闯进新海诚风蔚蓝海湾！展开光翼掠过海上电车与红鸟居山坡，自由滑翔冲刺，还能一键触发平行世界破坏与时光倒流。
zh-CN.controls: WASD 漫游，F 振翅飞行，E 乘海上电车，Tab 平行世界破坏，鼠标控制视角。
